models.name: Nemotron-Labs Dory 4B
models.full_name: Nemotron-Labs Dory 4B (looped model: one shared block run 1-4 times)
models.why: A looped 4B that holds a 256K context at ~50 tok/s on a 12GB RTX 3060 with 16GB system RAM, keeping the KV cache off system RAM.

engines.quant: reported run; ~1,580 tok/s prefill; looped architecture runs one shared block 1-4 times so the 262,144-token context KV cache stays on the GPU
